name: What is the difference between chemical drain cleaners and professional drain cleaning?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between chemical drain cleaners and professional drain cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Chemical drain cleaners are often a temporary solution that can corrode pipes over time, particularly older or PVC pipes, leading to potential leaks or damage. Professional drain cleaning, such as snaking or hydro-jetting, physically removes blockages without harsh chemicals. This approach effectively clears the obstruction and can help prevent recurrence, offering a more thorough and long-term solution. A professional assessment can determine the safest and most effective method for your specific drain issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Chemical cleaners can damage pipes and offer temporary fixes, while professional methods like snaking or hydro-jetting physically remove blockages for a more thorough, lasting solution.
